name: BinHV45 (BB40 lower-band drop capitulation)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: Bollinger(40, 2) on close; bbdelta=|mid-lower|; pricedelta=|open-close|; closedelta=|close-close[-1]|; tail=|close-low|
entry_long: lower[-1]>0 AND bbdelta>close*buy_bbdelta/1000 AND closedelta>close*buy_closedelta/1000 AND tail<bbdelta*buy_tail/1000 AND close<lower[-1] AND close<=close[-1]
implementation_notes: Hyperopt params (buy_bbdelta, buy_closedelta, buy_tail) defaults in source. 1m timeframe -> fees dominate. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
